bio.text: Andrea James is running for governor of Massachusetts in 2026 as an independent; she first declared as a Democrat in March 2025 and changed her party affiliation to unenrolled in November 2025.
She is a former criminal defense attorney and a Roxbury resident.

She founded Families for Justice as Healing, a Massachusetts nonprofit focused on ending incarceration of women and girls, and is founder and executive director of the National Council for Incarcerated and Formerly Incarcerated Women and Girls.
